name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.68.0 — one hand authors every mock and one token set backs every register (specs/20260902/09-one-hand-wireframes-one-token-set.md): design.md § Design Atlas's authorship paragraph is replaced — every mock, wireframe or themed, is authored and edited in-session by one hand, no `Agent` dispatch ever writes a mock at any stage or tier (subagents run judgment-free checks only), and grounding opens at the mocks seed/canon; `/spec:atlas` and `/spec:sketch` drop their sequential-Fable-dispatch/Sonnet-mechanical-edit split and cite the shared paragraph, printing `🎨 authored {N} in-session · {K} check-only dispatches`; core.md § Model Placement's parenthetical follows. mocks.md gains `## Mocks: Authoring Rules` (the six dry-run-converged wireframe/theme rules as contract prose). `spec/templates/mocks/viewer.css` ships shadcn's default zinc tokens and the full chrome register (`.v-card .v-btn .v-badge .v-input .v-bar .v-chip` + gallery/lightbox/matrix-toolbar rules on `--v-*` roles only); `wire-tokens.css` gains `--muted-bg` and is pinned value-equal to `viewer.css` per role; `wire.css` is re-based onto those roles with dashed `--border` placeholders, gray `--muted-bg` fills, no shadow, and no filled button but `.btn.primary` on `--muted-bg`. tests/mocks/viewer-tokens.test.js, tests/consistency/design-doctrine.test.js, tests/consistency/genesis-doctrine.test.js. 7.67.0 — look-stop block made copyable and navigable (direct fix, core § Incident Policy): the design stage's Step 5 prints the catalog command in a fenced code block with blank lines around it, one 🆕 line per BOUND STORY as the sidebar path `<title> / <story name>` resolved from the coverage-ledger claim's story ids through the stories file (never a component name — the 2026-09-03 field host files every story under one title with localized story names, so a search for the export name finds nothing), one ℹ️ line per component changed without a new story pointing at the story that shows it, and a fixed ↻ `Storybook already running? restart it so the sidebar re-indexes.` line. Before: the command was a bare indented line jammed against the 🆕 lines, and the 🆕 lines were component export names. Shared § Design Atlas `Look stops are never questions` now defines the fenced command, viewer-native 🆕 lines (story path for catalogs, served path for mocks) and the ↻ line for every look stop; tests/design-look-handoff.test.js re-pinned. 7.66.0 — `Depends on:` accepts a brief id with a trailing note (direct fix, core § Incident Policy): briefs spell dependencies as `16 (the review driver this brief mirrors)`; the item-wise parser rejected the item, so briefs 18, 19 and 23 silently carried no dependencies while status printed four remediation paragraphs for the tool's own strictness. spec-status.js now reads `NN`, `NN-name` or `brief NN` with one trailing parenthetical (commas inside it never split the item; header line breaks collapse); prose that is not an id still rejects and still surfaces as unparsed-dependency. Brief 24 (status-and-queue-diet) is staged for the shape that let this happen. tests/spec-status.test.js.
